ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT Name,xtype FROM sysobjects WHERE Name='POS_WanDoEksportu' AND xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF', N'FS', N'FT')) drop function CDN.POS_WanDoEksportu;

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.POS_WanDoEksportu (@PointOfSaleId int,@RowVersion int) RETURNS @Wan TABLE (WanID int,WanSymbol nvarchar(3)) AS BEGIN
declare @pckid int = (select PSa_pckid from cdn.PicoStanowiska where psa_id=@PointOfSaleId) insert into @Wan SELECT WaN_Id,WaN_Symbol from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.walnag on PcK_Waluta=WaN_Symbol where PcK_PicoID = @pckid AND @RowVersion = 0
insert into @Wan SELECT WaN_Id,WaN_Symbol from cdn.walnag join CDN.picowaluty on WaN_Symbol = Pwl_symbolM and PwL_PckId = @pckid where pwl_PckId = @pckid and PwL_TSArchiwizacji = 0--PwL_KursTS > @RowVersion and RETURN END
GRANT SELECT ON CDN.POS_WanDoEksportu TO CDNRaport
